title: Expected value with deterministic coordinates
statement: Let a finite-domain constraint satisfaction problem have a nonempty multiset of constraints, with every declared variable occurring in some constraint scope. Suppose the variable set is finite and has decidable equality, and consider a family of probability laws on the domain together with a finite list of variables such that every variable outside the list has a law concentrated at some label. Then the expected value of an assignment drawn independently from these laws equals the local expected value of the problem.
hypotheses_covered: Every declared variable occurs in a constraint scope
